jobs.title: React Frontend Developer
jobs.location: Remote; careers page says work from anywhere, Pakistan contract eligibility unconfirmed
jobs.description: Frontend product role covering responsive and accessible React interfaces, Figma implementation, REST/state integration, reusable components, testing, performance and work with design/backend colleagues. The full public JD is preserved in laralink-frontend.html. It asks for 3+ years of React, frontend foundations, Redux/Zustand, careful UI work, Git/CI-CD and communication; Next/TypeScript, Jest/RTL and open-source work are optional. Degree requirement absent from this complete public posting.
jobs.eligibilityEvidence: The current React listing says remote and flexible hours; the parent careers page says work from anywhere with async-friendly collaboration. Its title mentions Dhaka, the company gives Bangladesh addresses, and neither page explicitly confirms contracting/employing Pakistan residents. Treat this as promising geographic language, not final cross-border permission.

requirements.explanation: Danzee React Developer Jan2022–Jan2024 plus React product work at Tututor Nov2023–present establish more than three calendar years; overlap is not added.

requirements.explanation: Redux Toolkit and RTK Query are explicitly listed. Zustand is an alternative, not a missing mandatory second tool.

requirements.text: Demonstrate attention to interface detail and clean UI.
requirements.explanation: Reusable React components and hooks, Jurri file/inbox/vault interfaces, and Yaksport search/filter booking UI provide reasonable candidate-reported evidence of careful product-interface delivery. Git, GitHub, GitLab and CI/CD are explicitly in the original resume; no named cloud expertise or pipeline ownership has been invented.

Reported leadership of web/mobile delivery and direct product/engineering collaboration with the founder support this general collaboration requirement. This is not evidence of an English test level, fluency assertion or future time-zone commitment.

requirements.text: Optional: experience with Next.js or TypeScript.
